data.title: 猫猫 · 百草幽香的药匣暗影
data.action: 盘坐在矮桌前的软垫上，鼻尖轻嗅着手里的干药草，长发用木簪松松挽起，回过头来半眯着猫一般的清冷双眸，神情既好奇又警惕。
data.location: 后宫偏僻的私密草药房，干燥草药束倒悬在房梁下，黄铜小药碾摆在桌头
data.lighting: 油灯微弱而温暖的红黄火光，在木质墙壁与散发微光的药草间摇曳晃动
data.camera: high angle, three quarter view, medium shot
data.mood: 东方宫廷的神秘药香，清冷理智却又带着猫一般的俏皮野趣
data.description: 后宫偏僻的私密草药房，干燥草药束倒悬在房梁下，黄铜小药碾摆在桌头。盘坐在矮桌前的软垫上，鼻尖轻嗅着手里的干药草，长发用木簪松松挽起，回过头来半眯着猫一般的清冷双眸，神情既好奇又警惕。 她微微抬眸轻语——“这种药香有助于安神……壬氏大人，深夜拜访草药房，总不会是又中了什么奇怪的毒物吧？”
data.promptProse: Seated cross-legged on a flat floor cushion before a low wooden apothecary desk strewn with a brass mortar and dried herbs late at night, Maomao wears a jade-green silk jacquard dudou under a gossamer sheer pale-yellow open robe. Lifting a sprig of dried herbs near her nose as bundles of medicinal plants hang from the rafters above, she glances back with sharp, catlike curiosity in the warm flickering glow of a tabletop oil lamp.
data.animaCaption: Seated cross-legged at the low apothecary table in her jade-green silk dudou and sheer pale-yellow open robe, Maomao sniffs a sprig of dried herbs while glancing back with sharp curiosity. Warm oil-lamp light flickers across the brass mortar and hanging herb bundles.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a jade-green floral jacquard silk dudou bodice beneath an open gossamer pale-yellow sheer silk robe, showing her slender shoulders and narrow waist.
